items.name: Polyhue: Color Sort Puzzle
items.description: An offline water-sort puzzle game for Android. The game rules, level solver and generator are a pure Kotlin module with unit tests; the UI is Jetpack Compose with Room for saved progress. Levels are built in a separate Next.js editor.

images.alt: Polyhue level select in dark mode
